Subject: Follow-up + rotating demo slots (AvaTech)

Hi Alice — thanks again for the hour today. Quick recap of what we heard and a proposal for next steps so we can get the demo/technical deep-dive scheduled without everyone burning late-night hours: 

Recap (one line each):
- Use case: semantic search + summarization for multi-tenant customer support data.
- Main constraint: sub-200ms p95 for short queries; budget sensitivity across peak hours.
- Decision-maker cadence: weekly exec sync; ops/infra assessment next.

Proposal: run a 60-minute technical deep-dive/demo with product + infra (we'll bring an infra lead). To make it workable across your US/EU/APAC teams, can we rotate the slot weekly? Suggest starting with a US-friendly slot for week 1, EU-friendly for week 2, APAC-friendly for week 3. That keeps the same weekday/time window and shares meeting pain across teams.

Initial slot options (all 60 minutes) — please tell me which of these works, or paste preferred times and your TZ: 
- Option A (US-friendly): Tue 2025-10-14 09:00-10:00 PT / 12:00-13:00 ET
- Option B (EU-friendly): Tue 2025-10-14 16:00-17:00 CET / 10:00-11:00 ET
- Option C (APAC-friendly): Wed 2025-10-15 09:00-10:00 SGT / Tue 2025-10-14 20:00-21:00 ET

If you’re open, I can send a rotating-calendar invite (we use a short rotation rule: Week1 US, Week2 EU, Week3 APAC) and include a brief pre-demo checklist for your engineers. Attaching my call notes and a short tech-checklist we’d want to run through.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary), tech-checklist.xlsx (pre-demo asks)

Next steps: pick one of A/B/C or propose two alternatives and I’ll lock the calendar.

Thanks — Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
